question.text: A body floats in water with $40 \%$ of its volume outside water. When the same body floats in oil, $60 \%$ of its volume remains outside oil. The relative density of the oil is

solution.text:
Hints : Fraction of immersed part $f=\frac{d}{\rho}$
Case-1,
$f=1-0.4=0.6$
$0.6=\frac{d}{1}$
$d=0.6$
Case-2,


$$
\begin{aligned}
& f=1-0.6=0.4 \\
& f=\frac{d}{\rho_{\text {oil }}} \\
& 0.4=\frac{0.6}{\rho_{\text {oil }}} \\
& \rho_{\text {oil }}=1.5
\end{aligned}
$$
